en: The Triplet on the Visible, the Triplet on the Limited.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is visible, impinging, and limited, there arises a phenomenon that is visible, impinging, and limited, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under predominance condition there are twenty-one ...
pe ... under mutuality condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.

Dependent on a state that is non-manifestive, impinging, and sublime, there arises a state that is non-manifestive, non-impinging, and sublime by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-manifestive, impinging, and not immeasurable, there arises a state that is non-manifestive, non-impinging, and immeasurable by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
